description: Mailsoftly is an email marketing and automation platform for growing businesses, nonprofits, schools and PTAs, local governments, associations, professional services firms, marketing agencies, consultants, and corporate teams: organizations where email is essential but not anyone's full-time job. This app connects ChatGPT to your Mailsoftly account so you can work with it in plain language: look up contacts, lists, tags and segments, keep records tidy, import a CSV, draft campaigns and automations, ask how the last campaign did, and manage templates, forms, landing pages, images and your brand kit. Drafting and sending stay separate. The permission to send is an opt-in on the consent screen that starts switched off, so ChatGPT can prepare everything while you keep the send button, and every send follows the same deliverability checks, sender authentication and suppression rules as a campaign built by hand. The app reaches only the account you connect, within the permissions you approve, and records which app made which change. Works with your existing Mailsoftly plan; no separate fee.
